name: Bifrost JPL-C coding standard
description: Buildable JPL-C coding-standard policies mirrored from the public CodeQL C/C++ query pack.

policies.severity_rationale: Semaphore and task-lock primitives create shared execution state that JPL-C requires reviewers to avoid.
policies.remediation: Replace the primitive with the project's reviewed synchronization abstraction or document the bounded exception.

policies.severity_rationale: Heap allocation after initialization expands lifetime and failure obligations in safety-critical code.
policies.remediation: Move allocation into the initialization phase or replace it with a reviewed bounded-storage strategy.

policies.severity_rationale: Non-local jumps bypass ordinary structured control flow and complicate cleanup and review.
policies.remediation: Use structured error and control-flow handling instead of setjmp or longjmp.

policies.severity_rationale: Delay calls in safety-critical task code can create timing and synchronization behavior that is difficult to bound.
policies.remediation: Use the project's reviewed scheduling or synchronization primitive and document its timing contract.
